meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 它会判断改动属于 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR,同步更新八个清单文件里的版本号,跑构建同步、提交、打 tag、推送、建 GitHub release、重新生成 CHANGELOG,最后把 npm 发布交给你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要求给插件发新版本或递增版本号时接管,从改版本一直做到建 GitHub release,再把 npm 发布这一步交回给你。

say.text: 把版本从 1.2.0 升到 1.2.1,走完整发布流程
say.note: 会更新八个清单文件、打 tag 并建 release

say.text: 这次是新功能,按 MINOR 递增版本并发布
say.note: 结束时提示你自己跑 npm publish

say.text: 检查所有清单文件里的版本号是否一致
say.note: 用 git grep 核对新旧版本字符串

howto.what_en: It classifies the change as PATCH, MINOR or MAJOR, updates the version in eight manifest files, runs build-and-sync, commits, tags, pushes, creates a GitHub release and regenerates the changelog. npm publish stays a manual step for you.
howto.when_en: When you ask to release a new plugin version or bump the version number, it takes over from editing versions through creating the GitHub release, then hands npm publish back to you.

say_en.text: Bump 1.2.0 to 1.2.1 and run the full release flow
say_en.note: Updates eight manifests, tags and creates the release

say_en.text: This is a new feature — do a MINOR bump and release
say_en.note: Ends by asking you to run npm publish yourself

say_en.text: Check that all manifest versions match
say_en.note: Uses git grep to compare old and new strings
